about: The companion catalogue (INBOX 1696 dd, v, kk): every act, pose, face and interaction the in-app and the desk companion can show, with what each side has built. One table both draw from: the app reads it as /companion-catalogue.json, the desk through FRONTEND_DIR. Ratchets: tests/test_companion_catalogue_1108.py. Build order: docs/roadmap/agent-remaining/atlascat-1108.md.
